reason: In src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:196-199,434 and src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:45-64, span-buf:s:* keys (previously Redis SETs, still described as set keys in buffer.py:57) are now operated on exclusively with ZSET commands (zadd, zscan, zcard, zunionstore, zpopmin) under the unchanged span-buf:s:* and span-buf:q:* key prefixes with no migration, prefix bump, or dual-read. During a rolling deploy, mixed SET/ZSET operations on the same keys will raise Redis WRONGTYPE errors (crashing ingestion and the flusher in src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/flusher.py:114-163) and prevent spans stored in existing SET keys from being flushed.
